name: telegram-dev
description: Telegram development, split by the API each surface actually speaks. telegram-bots covers the official HTTP Bot API — update_id as the only idempotency key, the allowed_updates default that drops three types in silence, the webhook secret header, rate limits as a design constraint, and Telegram Stars with its ten-second pre-checkout window. telegram-userbots covers MTProto and Telethon — the session file as a credential equal to the password, FloodWaitError as the API working rather than failing, and the account-ban risk a bot token does not carry. telegram-miniapps covers initData verification, the algorithm shipped as a runnable fixture, and the SDK package whose name moved.
